newsitem.title: UK: MBS-1 sets 9.5 bln BEF mortgage-backed FRN.
newsitem.headline: MBS-1 sets 9.5 bln BEF mortgage-backed FRN.

text.p: MBS-1 has launched a 9.5 billion Belgian franc mortgage-backed FRN in four tranches, joint lead managers Bacob Bank and UBS said on Tuesday.
The notes have a final maturity of February 2019.
